finding: Existing exact main-EXE wrapper roles validate initialized public COMCTL protocols; no additional product change was established by this audit.

coverage.progress: v6 ordinary horizontal/vertical, smooth and state changes; v5 capability guard retains native behavior
coverage.trackbar: v5/v6, two orientations, ticks and fixed length, native custom-draw ownership and input
coverage.updown: v5/v6, two orientations and sizes, buddy, input, notification cancellation and changed delta

negative_and_lifetime: Each role has an exact-name impostor rejection and callback removal/destruction checks; trackbar checks bounded GDI/USER counts. UpDown records total GDI/USER counts but does not assert a zero-delta total.
package: S7 clean candidate: 87 cases passed with no skips in 347.55 seconds on self-owned private desktops; native fixture is not a real Delphi application. Four tested files published to assets and O:/winnt/system32 with matching SHA-256.
demo_observer: An initial run reported styled GDI counts 91, 91, 88 and failed an equality assertion despite a decrease. The revised second-reopen check rejects growth above the settled count and reports the actual final value; it does not establish the source of the decrease or prove zero leakage.
limits: Special styles and application custom drawing retain native behavior. Real Delphi runtime/package variants and physical input require separate evidence at T18 final closure.
